topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 250 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 2 ERC4626 vaults, 27 ERC20 tokens, 9 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 9 functional families. Its contracts share 16 common project-authored base contract(s) (poolconstant, poolerrors, stakingproxybase). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
